results.claim: The entire support spectrum and all stalks are reconstructed; E=(e) retains the supported integer zero and V(e) is the closed arithmetic stratum. The supported-zero prime theorem is prior foundational work, attributed by the originator to Gemini 2.5 Pro, not a new result.

All adelic boundary faces give a nonsplit global extension 0→K(s)→B(s)→C²→0; its two independent connecting classes evaluate at p to (p^{-s}−1)e_p and (p^s−1)e_infinity. The exact local differential gives both complementary determinant factors and every Weil prime-power term.

Full-prime-space recollement gives Ri!F=[A→B_X]. The universal arithmetic coupling gives relative principal parts F_X/O_X; for Spec Z its relative degree one is Q/Z=direct sum_p Q_p/Z_p. All finite pairings and filtration maps are explicit.

The actual p-to-one map on Q_p/Z_p has pullback norm sqrt(p). Its explicit local unitary dilation has matrix coefficients p^{−|n|/2}; they produce exactly the Poisson spectral measure and the original Weil prime energy, including its subtracted diagonal.

The computed relative operator satisfies T* T=T T*=pI and has full Hilbert spectrum |z|=sqrt(p). This is a local complex weight-one norm identity; the full Deligne-style purity statement for the interior cohomological image has not been proved.

Every nonzero integer acts on Q/Z with its exact degree and a common finite-adelic unitary dilation. The integral-vector Gram matrix is gcd(m,n)/sqrt(mn), with its classical Smith determinant fully proved. Supported zero and tau have different explicitly computed distributional actions.

The original relation complex is reconstructed over the full support trajectory lattice, with original invariant columns and all four separate attained metrics. These comparison maps preserve earlier calculations without substituting them for purity.

unproved: Full interior compact-support-to-ordinary cohomology image and its purity
